messages:
nora: Quick sync: compact prompt-eval rows look great for scanning but we're losing reviewer context on approve. People can't tell *why* a diff was accepted. Thoughts?
ben: Could we put a 1-word reviewer gist visible and a chevron to expand details? Keeps density but surface intent.
lee: Agree. For screen-reader users we must ensure the hidden text is accessible via a toggle button with aria-expanded and an aria-controls pointing at the full note.
tess: Microcopy idea: show short gist as `Reason: brevity` rather than just `brevity`. Makes intent clearer at a glance.
nora: Nice. Also for bulk-approve: the toast currently says "approved". Can we include first 80 chars of reviewer note in the toast so context isn't lost?
ben: Yeah, toast proposal: `Approval recorded for 9 items. Note preview: "{first 80 chars}"` — polite live region.
a11y-bot: Accessibility nits:
- Ensure the reason toggle is reachable by keyboard and has descriptive aria-label like `Show reviewer note for diff {id}`.
- Toast should be announced with role="status" (polite) and include the note preview truncated to words, not characters.
lee: Small keyboard flow change: Enter on primary CTA should open inline note; Ctrl/Meta+Enter confirms. Reduces accidental approvals.
tess: Copy variants for CTA: A) `Confirm approval` B) `Approve and record` C) `Approve (no note)` — we can test which reduces accidental submits.
nora: Action items: Ben to mock pill+chevron + toast, Lee to prototype keyboard mapping, Tess to draft CTA variants and microcopy, a11y-bot to produce announcement phrasing. I'll collect mocks and run a 5-person keyboard-first hallway test.
ben: Dropping mock link: https://figma.redwood/compact-approval-2026 comments on frames.
tess: Draft announcement: `Approval saved for {n} items. Reviewer note preview: "{summary}". Focus returned to nearest visible diff.` Posting in PRD.
nora: Thanks — schedule follow-up tomorrow after mocks. :sparkles:
